title: Combat/Mechanics

{{For|information about the combat [[Skills|skill]]|Combat|R=This article is about combat mechanics.}} ==Damage== In Stardew Valley, damage dealt to monsters is determined by a combination of weapon stats, rings, professions, and [[Luck]]. ===Formula overview=== FinalDamage = (BaseDamage × CritMultiplier (if crit)
    + Attack (stat) × 3)
    × FighterBonus (×1.1 if active)
    × BruteBonus (×1.15 if active)
    × DesperadoBonus (×2 if crit and active)
    → Modified by enchantments
    → Reduced by monster defense ===Base damage roll=== * A random value is rolled between the weapon’s minDamage and maxDamage. * [[Forge#Weapon forging|Ruby forging]] increases a weapon's minDamage and maxDamage by 10% per Ruby (up to 3). Three Ruby forges would increase minDamage and maxDamage by 30% total. * [[Ruby Ring]]s and [[Iridium Band]]s affect minDamage and maxDamage by 10% per ring. These effects are multiplicative with the [[Forge#Weapon forging|Ruby forging]] increase. * This makes the effective minDamage and maxDamage formula minDamage = weaponMinDamage × (100% + rubyForgeCount × 10%) × (100% + ringBonusPercent), where ringBonusPercent is the sum of all equipped ring effects which increase Attack by a percentage. If a player equipped two combined rings of [[Iridium Band]] and [[Ruby Ring]], ringBonusPercent would be 10% (Ruby Ring) + 10% (Iridium Band) + 10% (Ruby Ring) + 10% (Iridium Band) = 40%. ===Critical Hit Check=== * Base crit multiplier is 3x * If a crit occurs, the base damage is multiplied by critMultiplier, which is calculated as: critMultiplier = 3 + (CritPower / 50) × (1 + CriticalPowerMultiplier) * CritPower is the total of the [[Crit. Power]] stat from [[Weapons]] and [[Forge#Weapon forging|Jade forging]]. * CriticalPowerMultiplier is the effects of buffs: [[Forge#Enchantments|Innate enchantments]] and [[Jade Ring]] ===Attack Stat Bonus=== * The player’s Attack stat (from food, gear, and +Attack [[Forge#Enchantments|Innate enchantments]]) adds: +3 damage per Attack point ===Profession Bonuses=== * Fighter: +10% damage * Brute: +15% damage * These are applied multiplicatively and stack, so if both Fighter and Brute are active, the effective damage increase is 110% × 115% = 127%. ===Desperado Profession=== * If the hit is a critical strike and the player has the [[Skills#Combat|Desperado]] profession, damage is doubled. ===Enchantments=== If a weapon is [[Forge#Combat enchantments|enchanted]] with Bug Slayer or Crusader and the damaged monster type matches the enchantment effect, damage is increased by 50%. ===Monster defense=== Monster defense is subtracted from the damage roll. Damage is always at least 1, even after defense reduction. ==Critical hit chance== ===Calculation=== Critical hit chance is computed in the following order: '''Calculate weapon crit chance''' In 1.5, the [[Forge#Weapon forging|Aquamarine forging]] increases weapon critical hit chance by 4.6%. CritChance = Base weapon crit. chance + (4.6% × number of Aquamarine forges) If weapon type is [[Weapons#Dagger|dagger]], CritChance = (CritChance + 0.5%) × 1.12 '''Apply [[Aquamarine Ring]] and [[Forge#Innate enchantments|innate enchantments]]''' Each [[Aquamarine Ring|aquamarine ring]] equipped gives a 10% bonus. If the weapon has a "+X Crit. Chance" [[Forge#Innate enchantments|innate enchantment]], then each enchantment level adds a 2% bonus (up to 6% for a level 3 enchantment). (The tooltip displays "+1 Crit. Chance" for a level 1 enchantment.) CritChance = (CritChance × (1 + number of Aquamarine rings × 10% + Innate enchantment level × 2%) '''Apply Blessing of Fangs bonus''' If the Blessing of Fangs buff from [[Statue Of Blessings]] is active, Critical hit chance gets an additive increase of 10%. CritChance = CritChance + 10% '''Apply Scout profession''' If the player has the Scout Profession, critical hit chance is increased by 50%. CritChance = CritChance × 150% '''Apply Luck''' Critical hit chance is increased based on the player's [[Luck]]. CritChance = LuckLevel * CritChance / 40 ===Examples=== '''[[Galaxy Sword]] build''' * Aquamarine forging x3 * Aquamarine ring x2 * Blessing of Fangs * Scout profession * 2 Luck Calculation: # Weapon crit chance: 2% + (4.6% × 3 (Aquamarine forging)) = 15.8% # Rings & innate enchantment: 15.8% × (1 + 10% × 2 (Aquamarine rings)) = 15.8% × 120% = 19.0% # Blessing of Fangs: 19% + 10% = 29% # Scout profession: 29% × 150% = 43.4% # Luck: 43.4% + 2 (Luck) × 43.4% / 40 = 43.4% + 2.2 = 45.6% ==Critical hit damage== ===Calculation=== A critical strike does additional damage to an enemy. A special sound plays when hitting a critical strike, and the damage numbers that pop up show the greater damage amount. A critical strike effectively multiplies the damage roll by a calculated value called CritMultiplier. Default crit multiplier is 3x with the formula as follows: CritMultiplier = 3 + (Crit. Power (stat) / 50) × (1 + Crit. Power Bonus) The [[Skills#Combat|Desperado]] Profession also affects the damage dealt by a Critical strike, doubling damage after bonus [[Attack]] damage has been added. ([[Attack]] stat is otherwise a "flat" bonus which is not increased by Critical strike bonuses.) [[Crit. Power]] (stat) can be found on: * [[Weapons]] * [[Forge#Combat enchantments|Jade enchantments]]: +5 Crit. Power per enchantment Crit. Power Bonus is increased by: * [[Jade Ring]]: +10% per ring * [[Forge#Innate enchantments|Innate enchantments]]: +50% per enchantment level. A Crit. Power Innate enchantment shows as +25 "Crit. Power" per level, so a "+75 Crit. Power" tooltip represents a level 3 enchantment and thus increases Crit. Power Bonus by 150%. ===Example=== * A normal attack using the [[Lava Katana]] can do 55-64 damage. Assume an attack rolls 60 damage. * A Lava Katana has 25 Crit. Power, so CritMultiplier = 3 + (25 / 50) = 3.5 * If the Lava Katana was forged with 3 Jades, Crit. Power would be increased by 15, for a total of 40 (though it shows up as +39 ingame due to rounding errors). This means the damage would instead be CritMultiplier = 3 + ((25 + 15) / 50) = 3 + (40 / 50) = 3.8. * With 2 Jade Rings and a +75 Crit. Power (level 3) innate enchantment, Crit. Power Bonus would equal (2 × 10% (Jade Ring)) + 150% (Innate enchantment) = 170% (1.7x), making CritMultiplier = 3.8 × (100% + 170%) or 3.8 × (1 + 1.7) = 3.8 × 2.7 = 10.26. * A base damage roll of 60 damage that was a critical strike with this setup would deal 60 × 10.26 = 615.6 damage. * The [[Skills#Combat|Desperado]] effectively doubles the damage again (after the Attack stat is applied), so the resulting damage would be 615.6 × 2 = 1231.2. ==Player defense== ===Damage variance=== Monster damage varies by a random fluctuation between 7/8ths and just below 9/8ths of the [[Monsters|Monster]]'s base damage. The formula can be expressed as follows: minDamage <= actualDamage < maxDamage, where fluctuationDamage = int(monsterBaseDamage / 8) and minDamage = monsterBaseDamage - fluctuationDamage and maxDamage = monsterBaseDamage + fluctuationDamage. Example: A [[Shadow Brute]] has a base damage of 18, so fluctationDamage = 18 / 8 = 2.25 => 2, meaning the actual damage ranges between 16 and 19, because 18 - 2 = 16 and 18 + 2 = 20, but the upper bound is less than 20 (not less than or equal). ===Determining player defense=== Applicable defense is the player's [[Defense]] stat total from among [[Boots]], [[Weapons]], [[Rings]], [[Food]] buffs plus 1 if the player has read [[Jack Be Nimble, Jack Be Thick]]. If defense is greater than or equal to half the actual damage being dealt, defense is reduced by up to 20% . This causes a slight dampening of the defense stat in low-damage scenarios. If defense >= damage / 2, defense is reduced by either 0%, 10%, or 20% (randomly determined), using the following formula: defenseReduction = int(defense × reductionPercent), defense = defense - defenseReduction. Example: A [[Duggy]] has a base damage of 6. If 6 damage would be dealt to a player with a [[Defense]] of 5, half of 6 damage is 3. Since 5 (Defense) >= 3 (half damage), defense could be lowered by up to 20%. 5 (Defense) × 20% = 1, so in this scenario a player's effective defense could be reduced by up to 1. ===Damage is applied=== Incoming damage is reduced by the applicable defense, to a minimum of 1. Example: 10 damage is dealt to a player with 6 defense. The player would take 4 damage, because 10 - 6 = 4. ==References== See weapons.xnb file in the game data. See StardewValley::RubyEnchantment. See StardewValley::AquamarineEnchantment. See StardewValley::Tools::MeleeWeapon.DoDamage; the dagger weapon type is 1. See StardewValley::Tools::MeleeWeapon.DoDamage and StardewValley::Objects::Ring. See StardewValley::GameLocation.damageMonster. See StardewValley::GameLocation.damageMonster; the formula does not edit the crit chance but luck level is added in the if statement to check for a crit. See StardewValley::StardewValley::Farmer.takeDamage().
